record_and_cache_offsets_basis: Native consumer arithmetic at 0x400f43be..0x400f43de plus the established M1 record base; broader owner lifetimes still require per-track audit.
current_extension_limits: One 344-byte M1 state and one 64-byte private event arena.
M1-only descriptor predicate, fixed UI handle, fixed cache slot and fixed kit offset.
One source owner/request owner and one settings publication slot.
Page title, shortcut guard and getters currently M1-specific.
sequencer_blockers: Existing two-byte extension word already encodes MODE/RATE/GATE; it cannot hold 16 step offsets.
A separate owned saved block/schema and import/export migration are required, or an explicitly temporary RAM-only prototype.
Synth editor callbacks cannot safely be reused with MIDI records without new accessors.
Normal sequenced chord feeding and queued/sustained handoff must be proved before four-track release.
